The evidence presented is not conclusive because it does not say which regions have the selection. Looking at the paper Table 2 shows that the signal regions require N b-jets = 0 but VRtt WZ in Table 7 has b-jets and MET selection. We should be abel to cover both types of queries - looking at what was covered in signal regions vs what was covered in validation or control regions. The answer here is yes for VR but no for SR. This distinction is lost in the current schema so that needs to be fixed (making MRs now).
